selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the first thing said in the passage?
questions.answer: It begins by mentioning Allah’s name.

questions.question: Which two qualities of Allah are named in the English part?
questions.answer: Mercy and compassion.

questions.question: What does the passage say people ask Allah for?
questions.answer: Help.

questions.question: Who is called the Lord and Sustainer of all the worlds?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: Upon whom are blessings and peace sent?
questions.answer: Upon Prophet Muhammad, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: Why does the speaker say he will share a few truths?
questions.answer: Because someone asked him for some advice.

questions.question: How many short stories are mentioned?
questions.answer: Eight.

questions.question: What kind of examples are these stories said to be?
questions.answer: They are comparisons related to military life.

questions.question: Who does the speaker say needs the advice most?
questions.answer: His own nafs, meaning his own self.

questions.question: What important phrase opens the passage in Arabic and English?
questions.answer: A statement beginning in Allah’s name.

questions.question: Besides Allah’s name, what else is included near the beginning?
questions.answer: Praise to Allah and prayers for peace and blessings on Prophet Muhammad, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: What did the other person want from the speaker?
questions.answer: A small amount of advice.

questions.question: What form will the advice take?
questions.answer: It will come through eight short stories that compare things.

questions.question: Why are the comparisons connected to soldiers?
questions.answer: Because the person being spoken to is a soldier.

questions.question: What does the speaker admit about himself?
questions.answer: He says he himself needs advice more than anyone else.

questions.question: What inspired the longer advice he gave before?
questions.answer: Eight verses from the Qur’an.

questions.question: How is the new advice different from the earlier one?
questions.answer: This time it will be shorter and easier to understand.

questions.question: Who is invited to listen along with the speaker?
questions.answer: Anyone who wishes to listen.

questions.question: What does the passage teach us to do before giving advice or speaking?
questions.answer: Begin by remembering Allah and asking Him for help.

questions.question: What is Allah praised as being for all creation?
questions.answer: The Lord and caretaker of all worlds.

questions.question: What special respect is shown to Prophet Muhammad in the passage?
questions.answer: Prayers for blessings and peace are sent upon him.

questions.question: Which other people are included with Prophet Muhammad in that prayer?
questions.answer: His family and companions.

questions.question: What was the speaker asked to give?
questions.answer: Some words of advice.

questions.question: What number helps organize the advice in the passage?
questions.answer: The number eight.
